title: Brazil FDI Observatory
author: Fernando Barbosa
lag_criterion: BIC on a common maximum-lag sample
identification: Recursive Cholesky in declared variable order; Brazil lags excluded from NFCI equation; correlated residual vectors preserve contemporaneous covariance.

svar.stationarity_gate: ADF p>0.10 and KPSS p<0.05 blocks a level input; no automatic silent re-specification
svar.inference: residual-vector bootstrap, fixed selected lag and exogenous path, refit restricted system and re-identify every replication

local_projections.identified_shocks: same fitted structural shocks as SVAR
local_projections.boundary: inherits structural identification; not independent causal evidence

municipal_did.treatment: first verified operational foreign-invested establishment opening, not announcement
municipal_did.inference: municipality-clustered multiplier bootstrap; simultaneous confidence bands
gates: five clean pre-periods and five post-periods
no personal microdata in public export

measurement_rules: Never combine BPM5 and BPM6 silently
Negative and suppressed values are not zero
Country-sector cells require a published joint distribution
Municipal context and project locations are not measured municipal FDI
Source vintages and boundary years are explicit
Quarterly FDI USD converted monthly at the period-average BRL/USD rate and divided by quarterly nominal BRL GDP; conversion is part of the estimand
Reer direction must follow the selected source definition
No causal claim if diagnostics or identification gates fail
release_policy: Article draft and local preview only; no public publication or scheduling

historical_research.title: Determinantes do Investimento Estrangeiro Direto no Brasil no período de 1995 a 2010
